---
title: "Global correlation between transcriptomic and proteomic expression levels"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Load library
library(pheatmap)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
prot_raw <- read_excel("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/07.tissue-specific/04.pattern_heatmap/input/01.Dpse_protein_merge_LFQraw -2.xlsx")
prot_raw <- as.data.frame(prot_raw) %>%
  mutate(...1 = make.unique(...1, sep = "-")) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
prot_raw <- as.matrix(prot_raw)
prot_raw <- prot_raw[rowMeans(prot_raw) > 100000, ]

rna_raw <- read_csv("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/07.tissue-specific/04.pattern_heatmap/input/01.raw_mean_rpkm5.csv")
rna_raw <- as.data.frame(rna_raw) %>%
  mutate(...1 = make.unique(...1, sep = "-")) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
rna_raw <- as.matrix(rna_raw)
rna_raw <- rna_raw[rowSums(rna_raw) > 9, ]

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_raw), colnames(prot_raw))
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(rna_raw), rownames(prot_raw))

cat("Transcriptome number:", nrow(rna_raw), "\n",
    "Proteome number:", nrow(prot_raw), "\n",
    "Overlap:", length(common_genes), "\n")
```
```{r}
data_rna  <- rna_raw[common_genes, common_samples]
data_prot <- prot_raw[common_genes, common_samples]

if (identical(rownames(data_rna), rownames(data_prot)) && 
    identical(colnames(data_rna), colnames(data_prot))) {
  message("Proteomic and transcriptomic datasets are matched.")
} else {
  stop("Proteomic and transcriptomic datasets are not matched.")
}
```
```{r}
mean_rna <- rowMeans(data_rna)
mean_prot <- rowMeans(data_prot)
scatter_df_global <- data.frame(
  Mean_RNA = mean_rna,
  Mean_Prot = mean_prot
)

cor_res <- cor.test(scatter_df_global$Mean_RNA, scatter_df_global$Mean_Prot, 
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

r_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3) 
p_val <- cor_res$p.value
p_val

p_text <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 4)))
n_val <- nrow(scatter_df_global)  

stat_label <- paste0("Spearman R = ", r_val, "\n", p_text, "\nN = ", n_val)

p_global_final <- ggplot(scatter_df_global, aes(x = log10(Mean_RNA + 1), y = log10(Mean_Prot + 1))) +
  geom_point(color = "#404040", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", linetype = "solid", size = 1, se = TRUE) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = 0.2, y = 11.5,          
    label = stat_label, 
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,       
    size = 3.5,                 
    fontface = "italic",       
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 5),          
    breaks = seq(0, 5, 1)      
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(4, 12),         
    breaks = seq(4, 12, 2)     
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global RNA vs Protein Expression",
    x = "Log10 (Mean RPKM + 1)",
    y = "Log10 (Mean LFQ + 1)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() 
  )

print(p_global_final)
```
